zip_hq_approval_ready_trigger.description: Runs when an approval step on a request becomes ready for its approver, with who it waits on and when it is due. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. With Zip's webhooks pointed at Lodol it starts within seconds; otherwise how often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.approval: The whole approval step as Zip gives it.
output.name: The step's name, such as Finance approval.
output.queue_name: The team queue it belongs to, if any.
output.request_id: The id of the request it is on.
output.status: Its status as Zip shows it.
output.step_type: What kind of step, such as APPROVAL or FINALIZE_PAYMENT.

parameters.description: Only approvals on requests of this type. Leave blank for every type.
parameters.name: request_type

output.approved_at: When it was approved (ISO 8601, UTC), if it has been.
output.invoice: The whole invoice as Zip gives it.
output.invoice_id: The invoice's id, for the invoice steps.
output.invoice_url: A link that opens the invoice in Zip.
output.status: Its status, such as PENDING_APPROVAL, APPROVED or PAID.

parameters.description: Only those with this vendor. Leave blank for every vendor.
